title: Outrageously Large Neural Networks: The Sparsely-Gated Mixture-of-Experts Layer
abstract: Conditional computation via sparsely-gated MoE: thousands of experts, sparse gating, >1000x capacity with minor compute increase.

title: PackNet: Adding Multiple Tasks to a Single Network by Iterative Pruning
abstract: Iterative prune-and-pack sequential tasks into one network with binary masks; no extra compute at inference; requires task ID.

title: Progressive Neural Networks
abstract: Grow a new column per task with lateral connections; old columns frozen. Capacity grows linearly; inference of new tasks uses all columns.

title: Piggyback: Adapting a Single Network to Multiple Tasks by Learning to Mask Weights
abstract: Binary masks on a frozen backbone; task-specific sparse subnetworks; tiny storage per task; requires task ID.

title: Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning with Soft Modularization
abstract: Task-conditioned soft routing over a modular policy; MetaWorld-style manipulation; reduces gradient interference vs naive sharing.

title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
abstract: Frozen backbone plus low-rank adapters; mergeable at inference so no extra latency; 10,000x fewer trainable params vs GPT-3 full FT.

title: LIBERO: Benchmarking Knowledge Transfer for Lifelong Robot Learning
abstract: Lifelong robot manipulation benchmark; sequential finetuning can outperform existing lifelong methods in forward transfer.

title: TAIL: Task-specific Adapters for Imitation Learning with Large Pretrained Models
abstract: Per-task LoRA/adapters for continual imitation; 1% trainable params of full FT; avoids forgetting if task ID known at test.

title: Octo: An Open-Source Generalist Robot Policy
abstract: 93M/27M transformer generalist trained on 800k OXE trajectories; diffusion action head; finetune to new sensors/actions.

title: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model
abstract: 7B VLA on 970k demos; LoRA finetune on consumer GPUs; quantization without success-rate drop.

title: TinyVLA: Towards Fast, Data-Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
abstract: 70M–1.4B VLM plus diffusion action head; TinyVLA-H 1.3B total / 143M trainable; 5.5x fewer params and 20x lower latency than OpenVLA.

title: DeeR-VLA: Dynamic Inference of Multimodal Large Language Models for Efficient Robot Execution
abstract: Early-exit robotic MLLM; 5.2–6.5x LLM FLOPs and 2–6x GPU memory cut on CALVIN; 6 vs 24 layers only 3.2pp SR gap.

title: pi0: A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control
abstract: PaliGemma 3B VLM plus 300M flow-matching action expert; dual-module VLA; 3.3B total.

title: Efficient Diffusion Transformer Policies with Mixture of Expert Denoisers for Multitask Learning
abstract: Noise-conditioned MoE diffusion policy; 4 experts; 40% fewer active params and 90% fewer FLOPs vs dense DiT; SOTA on CALVIN/LIBERO 134 tasks.

title: DINO-WM: World Models on Pre-trained Visual Features enable Zero-shot Planning
abstract: Offline world model on frozen DINOv2 patches; test-time MPC; no expert demos or rewards.

title: ChatVLA: Unified Multimodal Understanding and Robot Control with Vision-Language-Action Model
abstract: Phased alignment plus MoE to reduce control/understanding task interference; 25 real-world manipulation tasks.

title: DexVLA: Vision-Language Model with Plug-In Diffusion Expert for General Robot Control
abstract: Separable 1B diffusion action expert pretrained then plugged into VLA; embodiment curriculum.

title: Knowledge Insulating Vision-Language-Action Models: Train Fast, Run Fast, Generalize Better
abstract: Stop-gradient from continuous action expert into VLM; discrete FAST tokens train backbone; dual-module interference is a training-dynamics problem.

title: SmolVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Affordable and Efficient Robotics
abstract: Small community VLA trained on one GPU; async inference; comparable to VLAs 10x larger.

title: Dynamic Mixture of Progressive Parameter-Efficient Expert Library for Lifelong Robot Learning
abstract: Progressive LoRA expert library plus context router; coefficient replay 5%; no test-time task ID; LIBERO lifelong.

title: MoLe-VLA: Dynamic Layer-skipping Vision Language Action Model via Mixture-of-Layers
abstract: Layer-as-expert skipping; up to 5.6x LLM compute cut and +8% SR; reduces not expands activated capacity.

title: Expertise need not monopolize: Action-Specialized Mixture of Experts for Vision-Language-Action Learning
abstract: Convert pi0 action-expert FFN to shared+routed MoE; +1.8pp LIBERO, +9.3pp RoboTwin hard, +21.5pp real.

title: Language-Conditioned Representations and Mixture-of-Experts Policy for Robust Multi-Task Robotic Manipulation
abstract: LCVR + LMoE-DP; ACT +33.75pp, DP +25pp; full framework 79% avg SR, +21pp over advanced baseline.

title: MemER: Scaling Up Memory for Robot Control via Experience Retrieval
abstract: Retrieve keyframes from experience; high-level VLM plus pi0.5 low-level; minutes-long memory without stuffing history into the policy.

title: MoE-ACT: Scaling Multi-Task Bimanual Manipulation with Sparse Language-Conditioned Mixture-of-Experts Transformers
abstract: Sparse MoE in ACT encoder, top-2, language FiLM; +33pp vs ACT on RoboTwin 2.0 six-task joint training (55% vs 22%).

title: CoRE-VLA: Towards Scalable and Robust Vision-Language-Action Modeling via Conditional Routing of Experts
abstract: Intent- and modality-conditioned sparse action DiT; LIBERO 98.7 avg; routing 8 experts lifts Long from 94.4 to 95.2.

title: RA-VLA: Retrieval-Augmented VLA for Test-Time Adaptation
abstract: Retrieval-augmented VLA; training-free test-time adaptation on LIBERO and UR5e.
